summary: No outstanding work clears the bar. Every acceptance criterion has a phase behind it. The live halves of V03, V04, V11-V13, V16 and V18 belong to the test phase by the plan's Ordering constraints, and V23-V25 are owed_after with close-out actions A2-A4. P12 closed the one gap consult 1 found: all 42 ledger rows match their clones, each clone is one commit ahead of origin and clean, and every file inherits the template its old file did. The eight firmware files and the four other jenkins-agent-large files declare yamlMergeStrategy merge(). The jenkins-agent template has no YAML, so the files that inherit only that template lose nothing. Close-out P11, the skill's POD-3 brief made stale by P12, was fixed as residue in KubeCoderConfig 9e26934 (plugin 0.10.3; kc project lint green) so it rides the one push. The other open entries are below the bar or sit in files the slice did not touch, and stay in the report.
